author: Driftlet
description_zh: 通用网页皮肤：把任意站点页面嵌进桌面挂件（本地外壳带拖动条与刷新按钮；站点地址在皮肤设置里改；登录态 cookie 持久化，定时自动刷新）
description_en: Generic web skin: embed any site page as a desktop widget (local shell with drag bar and refresh button; the site URL is a setting; login cookies persist; scheduled auto-refresh)

settings.description_zh: 要内嵌的页面地址（http/https）；目标站须允许被嵌（无 X-Frame-Options / frame-ancestors 限制）
settings.description_en: The page URL to embed (http/https); the site must allow framing (no X-Frame-Options / frame-ancestors)

settings.description_zh: 开启后按间隔定时刷新；关闭后只在手动点刷新按钮时重载
settings.description_en: When on, reloads on the interval; when off, only the manual refresh button reloads

settings.description_zh: 默认 5 分钟；页面隐藏时暂停，恢复可见立即补刷
settings.description_en: Default 5 minutes; pauses while hidden and catches up on becoming visible
